name: Electricians
intro: Find local electricians in Belagavi for house wiring, fan and light fitting, switchboard repairs, inverter installation and emergency fixes. Call or WhatsApp them directly; there's no middleman and no booking fee.

faqs.q: How much does an electrician charge for a home visit in Belagavi?
faqs.a: Most electricians in Belagavi charge a visit fee of about ₹100 to ₹200. This is often adjusted against the repair cost if you go ahead with the work. Always confirm the visit charge on the phone before they come.

faqs.q: Can I get an electrician the same day?
faqs.a: Yes, for small jobs like a fan, switch or MCB problem, most local electricians can come the same day, especially if you call in the morning. Big jobs like rewiring are usually scheduled a few days ahead.

faqs.q: Do electricians bring the materials or should I buy them?
faqs.a: Either works. Many customers buy switches, wires and fittings themselves from shops in Khade Bazar or Ganpat Galli and pay only for labour. Ask the electrician for a list of what to buy before the visit.

faqs.q: Who do I call for a power cut or a problem with the electricity meter?
faqs.a: Power cuts, meter faults and problems on the street line are handled by HESCOM, the electricity supply company, not by a private electrician. A private electrician handles wiring and fittings inside your home or shop.

faqs.q: How do I list my electrical business on belagavicity.com?
faqs.a: Basic listings are free. Use the 'List your business' option to send your business name, area, phone number and the services you offer.
